# Resource reference

5 resources. Reference material an agent reads on demand (`resources/read`). Each one is served through
the tool handlers named below, so a read has the same request budget, limits, metadata cache, scope rules, untrusted-data
envelope and audit entry (action `resource:<id>`) as the tool call it stands for. A resource whose tools are not allowed for the
workspace or grant does not exist: it is not listed and reading it fails. The plan: [tool catalogue](tool-catalogue.md#resources-phase-6).

| URI | Title | Served through | Content | MIME type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agility-bridge://reference/filters` | Structured filter vocabulary | `query_assets` | static | `text/markdown` |
| `agility-bridge://instance/asset-types` | Asset types of the instance | `list_asset_types` | tool | `text/plain` |
| `agility-bridge://instance/asset-types/{asset_type}` | One asset type | `describe_asset_type`, `list_asset_types` | tool | `text/plain` |
| `agility-bridge://workspace/projects` | Agility projects of this workspace | `list_projects` | tool | `text/plain` |
| `agility-bridge://rubrics/backlog-item-quality` | Backlog item quality rubric | `get_work_item` | static | `application/json` |

## `reference_filters`

`agility-bridge://reference/filters`

Cheat sheet of the structured filter vocabulary (operators, combining, sort, examples) used by query_assets.

Served through: [`query_assets`](tools.md#query_assets). Offered only when that tool is allowed for the workspace and grant.

## `instance_asset_types`

`agility-bridge://instance/asset-types`

The asset types this workspace allows on the instance, with base type, number prefix and scope strategy (the output of list_asset_types, as a snapshot).

Served through: [`list_asset_types`](tools.md#list_asset_types). Offered only when that tool is allowed for the workspace and grant.

## `instance_asset_type`

`agility-bridge://instance/asset-types/{asset_type}`

Attributes, operations, statuses and field tiers of one asset type (the output of describe_asset_type).

Served through: [`describe_asset_type`](tools.md#describe_asset_type), [`list_asset_types`](tools.md#list_asset_types). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant. A template: `resources/list` shows one URI per readable value.

## `workspace_projects`

`agility-bridge://workspace/projects`

The Agility projects this workspace allows, as a tree (built from list_projects).

Served through: [`list_projects`](tools.md#list_projects). Offered only when that tool is allowed for the workspace and grant.

## `rubric_backlog_item_quality`

`agility-bridge://rubrics/backlog-item-quality`

The versioned rubric (JSON) for judging backlog items: criteria, weights, scale and levels. work_item_quality uses the same rubric.

Served through: [`get_work_item`](tools.md#get_work_item). Offered only when that tool is allowed for the workspace and grant.
